name: tour-upload-hub
description: Private group tour photo/video upload hub — files stream straight into one Google Drive folder. Railway + GitHub ready.

scripts.check: node --check server/server.js && node --check server/app.js && for f in routes/*.js services/*.js middleware/*.js utils/*.js public/js/*.js scripts/*.js test/helpers/*.js test/*.test.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
